scope: Remove four self-checking tests and two private test doubles across protocol and transaction aggregates; no production edits.
reason: Only callers of each private fake were its own tests. The unary tests checked locally manufactured response/close/liveness values without exercising a transport consumer. Protocol tests mostly checked native APIs and local no-op methods.
retained_coverage: tidb-protocol/tests/packetio_source.rs: packet decoding, framing, sequence, compression, errors
tidb-txnkv/tests/physical_channel_evidence_source.rs: response identity and generation, publication, invalid version and typed shutdown errors
Rust Send and transaction-event nil regressions retained

grouped_tests.command: cd rust && cargo test --locked -p tidb-protocol -p tidb-txnkv --test all -- packetio_source physical_channel_evidence_source tikv_client_contract_source --test-threads=1

validation.hook: Actual hooks/pre-commit must run cargo build --locked -p tidb-server on this normal commit; final-handoff.json records its outcome and fresh pre-push gate.
validation.retained_coverage: PASS: five remaining contract test bodies, packet and physical-channel suites byte-identical; production and finding dispositions unchanged

limitations: No Cargo binary target removed and no measured build-time or workload gain.
No full Go/Rust suite, live cluster or complete package acceptance.
recovered_setup_issue: First documentation-update helper was run from rust instead of the repository root and failed before edits; rerun from the correct directory. Cargo test ran from its correct rust directory.
